journal: Can. J. Chem. 60, 1754-1758 (Bhatnagar and Campbell, Osmotic and activity coefficients of sodium sulphate in water from 150 to 250 C)
experimental_method: Vapour pressure lowering of Na2SO4 solutions measured in a high-pressure cell with a precision pressure transducer, 150-250 C, 0.29 mol/kg to saturation; solution molality by gravimetric BaSO4 analysis.
uncertainties_stated: Test with 1 m NaCl: osmotic coefficients within 1 % of literature.
quality_remarks: Temperature by platinum resistance thermometer; scale not stated. Highest-molality point of each isotherm is at saturation (literature solubility).
